explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/1173. Under GCH, for every set mapping f on ω_{ω+1} with α ∉ f(α), |f(α)| ≤ ℵ_ω and |f(α) ∩ f(β)| < ℵ_ω for α ≠ β, there is a free set (no β ∈ f(α) for distinct α, β in it) of cardinality ℵ_{ω+1}. The standard self-avoidance condition is made explicit, and GCH is a hypothesis. The open question is stated affirmatively.
